§6Americium-242m§f

§aThe fissile americium. Comes free when you make Am-241.§f

Americium-242m (specifically Am-242m1) is a rare fissile radioisotope used in advanced reactor fuels. Produced only by the decay of §bPu-241§f in RBMK reactors.

Properties: §e9.5§f RAD/s, fissile, hard difficulty.

Production via SILEX: same process as Am-241. Short-Lived Nuclear Waste + BiSmUTh crystal yields Am-242 alongside Am-241. Reactor Grade Americium gives §e66%§f Am-242, §e33%§f Am-241.

Uses: §bRBMK Fuel (HEA-242)§f (8 Am-242 billets = HEA-242 rod), §bPWR Fuel (HEA-242)§f (Am-242 billet + Insulator + Am-242 billet = PWR rod), and Reactor Grade Americium (combine with Am-241).

§ePS:§f Both Am-241 and Am-242m come from the same SILEX process. You get both simultaneously when processing Pu-241 waste.
